sections.title: Forgotten Superheroes of Science

sections.text:
Item #1: New observations of the star KIC 8462852 show that in addition to dimming it also undergoes periods of brightening, a fact that disproves most current hypotheses about what is causing the changes to the star’s brightness.
Item #2: Scientists have developed a new nanomaterial that can directly convert seawater into electricity, essentially using the ocean as a giant battery.
Item #3: Researchers find in an international study that people distrust those of different political ideology more than of different race or religion.
sections.title: Science or Fiction

sections.text: “Scientific literacy is an intellectual vaccine against the claims of charlatans who would exploit ignorance.” ― Neil deGrasse Tyson
